"""Source-gated selected surveyed-bridge Native construction for C230289.

Administrative declaration and sign status must come from an original survey.
Requested controller speed and observed Native velocity are distinct.
"""
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ASSIGNMENT = "training__C230289__NRS-484B-633-2__motor_vehicle_driver"
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(config):
    require(config["case_id"] in {ASSIGNMENT + "__probe_01", ASSIGNMENT + "__probe_02"} and config["law_id"] == "NRS-484B-633-2"
            and config["cell_id"] == "C230289" and config["actor"] == "motor_vehicle_driver",
            "exact assignment changed")
    require(config["frozen_cell"] == {"layout": "road", "maneuver": "travel",
                                      "control": "speed_limit_sign"}, "frozen cell changed")
    require(config["status"] == "selected_cpu_prepared"
            and not config.get("physical_completion") and config["legal_verdict"] is None,
            "unproved outcome claimed")
    require(config["rate_hz"] == 20 and config["duration_s"] == 30 and config["frames"] == 600,
            "30-second capture missing")
    require(config["requested_offset_from_declared_maximum_mph"] == (-10 if config["case_id"].endswith("probe_01") else 10),
            "speed request changed")
    require(tuple(c["name"] for c in config["cameras"]) == VIEWS
            and all(c["fps"] == 20 and c["width"] >= 1280 and c["height"] >= 720
                    for c in config["cameras"]), "four-camera source plan incomplete")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "frame_count": 600, "views": list(VIEWS),
            "carla_contacted": False, "selected": True, "measured_speed_mph": None}


def read_survey(path):
    survey = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    require(survey.get("assignment_id") == ASSIGNMENT and survey.get("source_kind") == "original_native_bridge_survey",
            "original assignment bridge survey required")
    require(survey.get("map_name") and survey.get("highway_source_id")
            and survey.get("structure_source_id") and survey.get("chapter_408_source_id")
            and survey.get("structure_type") in {"bridge", "other_elevated_structure"},
            "highway bridge geometry provenance missing")
    require(survey.get("fixed_cell") == {"layout": "road", "maneuver": "travel",
                                         "control": "speed_limit_sign"}, "survey cell mismatch")
    admin = survey.get("administrative_declaration", {})
    require(all(admin.get(key) for key in ("department_source_id", "investigation_source_id",
                                         "finding_source_id", "declaration_source_id",
                                         "otherwise_permissible_speed_source_id")),
            "administrative declaration provenance missing")
    maximum = admin.get("safe_maximum_mph")
    ordinary = admin.get("otherwise_permissible_speed_mph")
    require(isinstance(maximum, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(maximum) and maximum > 10
            and isinstance(ordinary, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(ordinary)
            and ordinary > maximum,
            "declared structural maximum must be below sourced otherwise permissible speed")
    signs = survey.get("signs", [])
    require(len(signs) == 2 and {s.get("end") for s in signs} == {"first", "second"}
            and all(s.get("source_id") and s.get("visible_instruction_source_id")
                    and s.get("department_authorization_source_id") and s.get("maintained_source_id")
                    and s.get("instruction_kind") == "structure_maximum"
                    and s.get("maximum_mph") == maximum and s.get("distance_before_end_ft") == 100
                    and s.get("governed_approach_source_id") and len(s.get("position_xyz_m", [])) == 3
                    and len(s.get("structure_end_xyz_m", [])) == 3 for s in signs),
            "two authorized 100-foot structural signs missing")
    require(all(abs(math.dist(s["position_xyz_m"], s["structure_end_xyz_m"]) * 3.280839895 - 100) <= 2 for s in signs),
            "structural sign coordinates do not support 100-foot distance")
    require(len(survey.get("spawn_xyz_yaw_deg", [])) == 4
            and len(survey.get("bridge_exit_xyz_m", [])) == 3
            and survey.get("vehicle_blueprint"), "surveyed Native route missing")
    polygon = survey.get("structure_polygon_xy_m", [])
    require(len(polygon) >= 3 and all(len(v) == 2 and all(isinstance(c, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(c) for c in v) for v in polygon),
            "surveyed structure footprint missing")
    return survey


def inside_polygon(x, y, vertices):
    inside = False
    j = len(vertices) - 1
    for i, (xi, yi) in enumerate(vertices):
        xj, yj = vertices[j]
        if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) and x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi:
            inside = not inside
        j = i
    return inside


def execute(config, output_dir, survey_path, host, port):
    check(config)
    require(survey_path, "original assignment bridge survey required")
    survey = read_survey(survey_path)
    require(".runtime-work" in os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT", ""),
            "set SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT under .runtime-work")
    repo = ROOT.parents[2]
    sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "runtime" / "scenario_pipeline"))
    sys.path.insert(1, str(repo / "runtime" / "python"))
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import restore, snapshot

    output = Path(output_dir)
    require(output.is_dir(), "materialized output directory required")
    (output / "original_bridge_survey.json").write_bytes(Path(survey_path).read_bytes())
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(15)
    world = client.get_world()
    original = snapshot(client)
    actors, sensors, encoders, codes = [], [], {}, {}
    completed = False
    images = queue.Queue()
    try:
        require(world.get_map().name == survey["map_name"], "survey map differs")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        bp = library.find(survey["vehicle_blueprint"])
        require(bp is not None, "vehicle blueprint unavailable")
        x, y, z, yaw = survey["spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
        vehicle = world.try_spawn_actor(bp, carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z),
                                           carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw)))
        require(vehicle is not None, "surveyed spawn occupied")
        actors.append(vehicle)
        for camera in config["cameras"]:
            camera_bp = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            camera_bp.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(camera["width"]))
            camera_bp.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(camera["height"]))
            camera_bp.set_attribute("fov", str(camera["fov_deg"]))
            cx, cy, cz = camera["location_xyz_m"]
            pitch, cyaw, roll = camera["rotation_pyr_deg"]
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(camera_bp, carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=cx, y=cy, z=cz),
                                       carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=cyaw, roll=roll)), attach_to=vehicle)
            actors.append(sensor)
            sensors.append(sensor)
            encoders[camera["name"]] = subprocess.Popen([
                "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
                "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "bgra",
                "-s", f"{camera['width']}x{camera['height']}", "-r", "20", "-i", "-",
                "-frames:v", "600", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "1",
                str(output / (camera["name"] + ".mkv"))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            sensor.listen(lambda image, name=camera["name"]: images.put((name, image)))
        with PipelineCapture(client, vehicle, output, config["case_id"], required_observations=config["required_atoms"]) as capture, \
                FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map, \
                (output / "bridge-native.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as trace:
            target_speed_mps = (survey["administrative_declaration"]["safe_maximum_mph"] + config["requested_offset_from_declared_maximum_mph"]) / 2.2369362920544
            for frame in range(600):
                pose, velocity = vehicle.get_transform(), vehicle.get_velocity()
                speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)
                target = survey["bridge_exit_xyz_m"]
                heading = math.atan2(target[1] - pose.location.y, target[0] - pose.location.x)
                relative = math.atan2(math.sin(heading - math.radians(pose.rotation.yaw)),
                                      math.cos(heading - math.radians(pose.rotation.yaw)))
                steer = max(-0.35, min(0.35, relative))
                throttle, brake = (0.55, 0.0) if speed < target_speed_mps else (0.0, 0.1)
                vehicle.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=throttle, brake=brake, steer=steer))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                observed_pose, observed_velocity = vehicle.get_transform(), vehicle.get_velocity()
                seen = set()
                while len(seen) < 4:
                    name, image = images.get(timeout=15)
                    if image.frame != native_frame or name in seen:
                        continue
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    seen.add(name)
                capture.capture(native_frame, frame / 20, extra={"video_frame": frame})
                frame_map.append(native_frame, frame / 20,
                                 native_elapsed_s=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
                trace.write(json.dumps({"source_kind": "original_native_observation", "frame": frame,
                                        "native_frame": native_frame, "t_s": frame / 20,
                                        "vehicle_id": vehicle.id, "structure_source_id": survey["structure_source_id"],
                                        "position_xyz_m": [observed_pose.location.x, observed_pose.location.y,
                                                           observed_pose.location.z],
                                        "velocity_xyz_mps": [observed_velocity.x, observed_velocity.y,
                                                             observed_velocity.z],
                                        "requested_speed_mph": survey["administrative_declaration"]["safe_maximum_mph"] + config["requested_offset_from_declared_maximum_mph"],
                                        "on_structure_verified": inside_polygon(observed_pose.location.x, observed_pose.location.y, survey["structure_polygon_xy_m"]),
                                        "structure_occupancy_source": survey["structure_source_id"]}) + "\n")
        for name, process in encoders.items():
            process.stdin.close()
            error = process.stderr.read()
            codes[name] = process.wait(timeout=180)
            require(codes[name] == 0 and (output / (name + ".mkv")).is_file(),
                    "Source camera encode failed: " + name + " " + error.decode()[-200:])
        completed = True
    finally:
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        for sensor in sensors:
            sensor.stop()
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        restored = restore(client, original)
        if completed and len(codes) == 4:
            seal_capture(output, frames=600, restoration=restored, errors=[],
                         encoder_exit_codes=codes,
                         context={"case_id": config["case_id"], "source_review": "pending"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--bridge-survey")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(config)))
    else:
        require(args.output_dir, "output directory required")
        execute(config, args.output_dir, args.bridge_survey or os.environ.get("SCENARIO_BRIDGE_SURVEY"),
                args.host, args.port)

import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("runner",ROOT/"runner.py")
runner=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
class SourceGatedBridgeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):self.config=json.loads((ROOT/"config.json").read_text())
    def test_exact_selected_controller_and_cameras(self):
        proof=runner.check(self.config)
        self.assertTrue(proof["selected"])
        self.assertEqual(proof["frame_count"],600)
        self.assertEqual(proof["views"],["overview","approach","reference_corner","driver_reference"])
    def test_missing_survey_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(Exception,"original assignment bridge survey required"):
            runner.read_survey(ROOT/"config.json")
    def test_requested_speed_does_not_prove_physical_or_legal_outcome(self):
        self.assertFalse(self.config["physical_completion"])
        self.assertIsNone(self.config["legal_verdict"])
    def test_wrong_case_rejected(self):
        self.config["case_id"]="wrong"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"exact assignment changed"):runner.check(self.config)
if __name__=="__main__":unittest.main()

"""Recorded-only bridge speed measurement and source channel extraction."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from bridge_speed_measure import MPS_TO_MPH
from finalize_bridge import finalize as bridge_finalize


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def bridge_speed(finding):
    return {'declared_maximum_mph': finding['declared_maximum_mph'],
            'max_observed_structure_speed_mph': finding['max_observed_structure_speed_mph'],
            'structure_frames_above_declared_maximum': finding['structure_frames_above_declared_maximum']}


def run(attempt, output):
    attempt, output = Path(attempt), Path(output)
    required = ('original_bridge_survey.json', 'bridge-native.jsonl',
                'video_frames.jsonl', 'trace.jsonl', 'capture/evidence.jsonl')
    for name in required:
        if not (attempt / name).is_file():
            raise ValueError('Missing required source: ' + name)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError('Choose a fresh analysis report')
    config = json.loads((attempt / 'config.json').read_text())
    case = config['case_id']
    diagnostic = os.environ.get('SCENARIO_DIAGNOSTIC_FIXTURE') == '1'
    finding = bridge_finalize(attempt, attempt / 'bridge-findings.json', diagnostic)
    survey = json.loads((attempt / 'original_bridge_survey.json').read_text())
    trace = [json.loads(row) for row in (attempt / 'bridge-native.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if row]
    channels = attempt / 'channels'
    channels.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    names = [item['name'] for item in config['recording_description']['channels']]
    expected = ['st.elevated_structure', 'dev.speed_limit_sign', 'dev.position',
                'dev.governs', 'kin.speed', 'rel.occupies', 'drv.approaching']
    if names != expected:
        raise ValueError('Selected source channels changed')
    evidence = []
    for name in names:
        path = channels / (name + '.jsonl')
        with path.open('x') as stream:
            for row in trace:
                if name == 'st.elevated_structure':
                    value = {'structure_source_id': survey['structure_source_id'],
                             'on_structure': row['on_structure_verified']}
                elif name == 'dev.speed_limit_sign':
                    value = [{'source_id': sign['source_id'],
                              'maximum_mph': sign['maximum_mph']} for sign in survey['signs']]
                elif name == 'dev.position':
                    value = [sign.get('position_xyz_m') for sign in survey['signs']]
                elif name == 'dev.governs':
                    value = [sign['governed_approach_source_id'] for sign in survey['signs']]
                elif name == 'kin.speed':
                    value = (sum(v * v for v in row['velocity_xyz_mps']) ** 0.5) * MPS_TO_MPH
                elif name == 'rel.occupies':
                    value = row['on_structure_verified']
                else:
                    value = {'position_xyz_m': row['position_xyz_m'],
                             'governing_sign_sources': [sign['governed_approach_source_id']
                                                        for sign in survey['signs']]}
                stream.write(json.dumps({'time_s': row['t_s'], 'value': value}) + '\n')
        evidence.append({'name': name, 'unit': 'structured',
                         'reference': 'channels/' + path.name})
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result
    result = {'case_id': case, 'measured_values': finding,
              'target_checks': [{'target': 'measured bridge speed relative to original DOT declaration',
                                 'requested': config['requested_offset_from_declared_maximum_mph'],
                                 'measured': bridge_speed(finding),
                                 'method': 'original 20 Hz Native velocity during surveyed structure occupancy',
                                 'tolerance': 'sampling interval 0.05 s; original source and legal review remain pending',
                                 'matched': False, 'physical_cause_confirmed': False,
                                 'cause_evidence': list(required)}],
              'setup_confirmed': False, 'behavior_attempted': False,
              'maneuver_completed': False, 'accepted': False,
              'termination_reason': 'Saved source measurement complete; physical and legal review pending',
              'physical_failure_flags': ['original_source_and_physical_review_pending'],
              'trace_reference': 'trace.jsonl',
              'video_references': [name + '.mkv' for name in
                                   ('overview', 'approach', 'reference_corner', 'driver_reference', 'raw')],
              'video_frame_map_reference': 'video_frames.jsonl',
              'recording_description': config['recording_description'],
              'recording_evidence': evidence, 'realized_observables': {},
              'physical_acceptance_claimed': False, 'legal_verdict_claimed': False}
    write_result(attempt, physical_result(attempt, result))
    sources = {name: sha(attempt / name) for name in required}
    report = {'format': 'worker-analysis-report', 'case_id': case,
              'measurements': {'bridge_speed': {'method': 'bridge_speed',
                                               'value': bridge_speed(finding),
                                               'sources': sources}},
              'source_complete': True, 'physical_or_legal_acceptance': False}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--attempt', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(run(args.attempt, args.output), sort_keys=True))

"""Saved-source bridge-speed diagnostic; physical and legal review stay open."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from bridge_speed_measure import ASSIGNMENT, measure


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def finalize(attempt, output, diagnostic_fixture=False):
    attempt, output = Path(attempt), Path(output)
    survey_path = attempt / 'original_bridge_survey.json'
    trace_path = attempt / 'bridge-native.jsonl'
    mapping_path = attempt / 'video_frames.jsonl'
    require(all(path.is_file() for path in (survey_path, trace_path, mapping_path)),
            'Missing original bridge survey, Native trace or frame map')
    survey = json.loads(survey_path.read_text())
    expected_kind = 'synthetic_native_sample' if diagnostic_fixture else 'original_native_bridge_survey'
    require(survey.get('assignment_id') == ASSIGNMENT and survey.get('source_kind') == expected_kind,
            'Original bridge survey identity missing' if not diagnostic_fixture else 'Synthetic fixture identity missing')
    trace = rows(trace_path)
    mapping = rows(mapping_path)
    require(len(trace) == len(mapping) == 600, '30-second original source join missing')
    require(all(row.get('frame') == i and maprow.get('video_frame') == i
                and row.get('native_frame') == maprow.get('native_frame')
                for i, (row, maprow) in enumerate(zip(trace, mapping))),
            'Original Native/video frame join missing')
    vehicle_ids = {row.get('vehicle_id') for row in trace}
    require(len(vehicle_ids) == 1 and None not in vehicle_ids, 'Original vehicle identity missing')
    trace_kind = 'synthetic_native_sample' if diagnostic_fixture else 'original_native_observation'
    require(all(row.get('source_kind') == trace_kind
                and row.get('structure_occupancy_source') == survey.get('structure_source_id')
                and type(row.get('on_structure_verified')) is bool for row in trace),
            'Original structure occupancy source missing')
    converted = {'assignment_id': ASSIGNMENT, 'source_kind': trace_kind,
                 'vehicle_id': next(iter(vehicle_ids)),
                 'frames': [{'frame': row['frame'], 't_s': row['t_s'],
                             'vehicle_id': row['vehicle_id'],
                             'structure_id': row['structure_source_id'],
                             'on_structure': row['on_structure_verified'],
                             'velocity_xyz_mps': row['velocity_xyz_mps'],
                             'requested_speed_mph': row['requested_speed_mph']}
                            for row in trace]}
    normalized_survey = dict(survey, source_kind=trace_kind)
    finding = measure(json.dumps(normalized_survey, sort_keys=True).encode(),
                      json.dumps(converted, sort_keys=True).encode())
    finding['original_bridge_survey_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(survey_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    finding['original_native_trace_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(trace_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    finding['original_frame_map_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(mapping_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    finding['case_id'] = json.loads((attempt / 'config.json').read_text())['case_id']
    finding['diagnostic_fixture'] = diagnostic_fixture
    finding['physical_completion'] = False
    finding['legal_result'] = None
    finding['source_review_pending'] = ['original structural designation and administrative records',
                                         'sign pixel/source position review',
                                         'physical bridge crossing review']
    output.write_text(json.dumps(finding, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    return finding


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--attempt', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--diagnostic-fixture', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize(args.attempt, args.output, args.diagnostic_fixture), sort_keys=True))

"""Source-bound diagnostic for a surveyed bridge maximum and measured crossing.

This reducer keeps administrative activation, bridge occupancy, and speed
separate. Synthetic packets test CPU behavior only; they are not evidence.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import math

ASSIGNMENT = "training__C230289__NRS-484B-633-2__motor_vehicle_driver"
MPS_TO_MPH = 2.2369362920544


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def measure(survey_bytes, trace_bytes):
    survey, trace = json.loads(survey_bytes), json.loads(trace_bytes)
    require(survey.get("assignment_id") == ASSIGNMENT and trace.get("assignment_id") == ASSIGNMENT,
            "assignment mismatch")
    require(survey.get("source_kind") == trace.get("source_kind")
            and survey.get("source_kind") in {"synthetic_native_sample", "original_native_observation"},
            "source kind mismatch")
    require(survey.get("fixed_cell") == {"layout": "road", "maneuver": "travel",
                                          "control": "speed_limit_sign"}, "fixed cell mismatch")
    require(survey.get("highway_source_id") and survey.get("structure_source_id")
            and survey.get("structure_type") in {"bridge", "other_elevated_structure"}
            and survey.get("chapter_408_source_id"), "highway structure provenance missing")
    admin = survey.get("administrative_declaration", {})
    require(admin.get("department_source_id") and admin.get("investigation_source_id")
            and admin.get("finding_source_id") and admin.get("declaration_source_id")
            and admin.get("otherwise_permissible_speed_source_id"),
            "structural maximum declaration provenance missing")
    maximum = admin.get("safe_maximum_mph")
    require(isinstance(maximum, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(maximum) and maximum > 0,
            "declared structural maximum missing")
    signs = survey.get("signs", [])
    require(len(signs) == 2 and {s.get("end") for s in signs} == {"first", "second"},
            "both structure-end signs required")
    require(all(s.get("source_id") and s.get("department_authorization_source_id")
                and s.get("maintained_source_id") and s.get("instruction_kind") == "structure_maximum"
                and s.get("maximum_mph") == maximum and s.get("distance_before_end_ft") == 100
                and s.get("governed_approach_source_id") for s in signs),
            "structural sign placement or instruction missing")
    frames = trace.get("frames", [])
    require(len(frames) >= 600 and all(f.get("frame") == i
            and abs(f.get("t_s", -1) - i / 20) < 1e-8 for i, f in enumerate(frames)),
            "30-second contiguous 20 Hz recording required")
    require(trace.get("vehicle_id") and all(f.get("vehicle_id") == trace["vehicle_id"] for f in frames),
            "vehicle identity changed")
    require(all(f.get("structure_id") == survey["structure_source_id"]
                and isinstance(f.get("on_structure"), bool) for f in frames),
            "structure occupancy source missing")
    require(all(isinstance(f.get("velocity_xyz_mps"), list)
                and len(f["velocity_xyz_mps"]) == 3
                and all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(v)
                        for v in f["velocity_xyz_mps"]) for f in frames),
            "measured Native velocity missing")
    occupied = [f for f in frames if f["on_structure"]]
    require(occupied, "no observed structure occupancy")
    speeds = [math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in f["velocity_xyz_mps"])) * MPS_TO_MPH for f in occupied]
    above = [f["frame"] for f, mph in zip(occupied, speeds) if mph > maximum]
    return {"format": "c230289-bridge-speed-diagnostic-v1", "assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT,
            "source_kind": survey["source_kind"], "survey_sha256": digest(survey_bytes),
            "trace_sha256": digest(trace_bytes), "frame_count": len(frames),
            "duration_s": len(frames) / 20, "structure_frame_range": [occupied[0]["frame"],
                                                                  occupied[-1]["frame"]],
            "declared_maximum_mph": maximum, "max_observed_structure_speed_mph": max(speeds),
            "structure_frames_above_declared_maximum": above,
            "requested_speed_used": False, "legal_result": None,
            "physical_completion": False,
            "unresolved": ["original geometry and signs", "administrative provenance",
                           "physical measured vehicle crossing"]}
